burro · run your coding agent's tests on your own server

Usage: burro <command> [flags]

Set up (once)
  host add <name> <user@host>   add a server

Server
  exec -- <command>             run one command on the server
  sync                          copy the code to the server without a run
  doctor                        check that the server is ready
  host ls                       list your servers

Exit codes  0 passed · 1 tests failed · 2 server problem · 3 still running
            4 bad config or flags · 5 another run is active

burro <command> --help   details and an example
